name: Foundation
description: The Foundation Level is the starting point for building essential technical skills, ensuring a smooth transition into advanced learning. It follows a structured, step-by-step approach, where each stage strengthens the knowledge gained in the previous one. From digital literacy and basic programming to network security and cybersecurity, this stage equips learners with the core competencies needed for future success. both in school and in the real world.

levels.name: Level 1: Introduction to Computers & Digital Literacy
levels.description: Students develop fundamental digital skills, including computer operation, internet usage, and essential software applications, ensuring a strong foundation for technical learning.

levels.name: Level 2: Introduction to Programming & Databases
levels.description: This stage introduces the basics of coding and database management, helping students understand how to write simple programs and organize data efficiently.

levels.name: Level 3: Networking & Basic Security
levels.description: Learners explore networking concepts, internet protocols, and basic security measures, equipping them with the knowledge to build and maintain secure digital environments.

levels.name: Level 4: Cybersecurity & Advanced Programming
levels.description: Advanced topics in cybersecurity and programming are covered, enabling students to protect systems from cyber threats while enhancing their coding skills for complex applications. Advanced topics in cybersecurity and programming are covered, enabling students to protect systems from cyber threats while enhancing their coding skills for complex applications.

name: Programming
description: track offers a fun and interactive way to learn coding skills. Through hands-on projects, children will explore the basics of programming, logical thinking, and problem-solving, helping them build creativity and prepare for a future in the tech world.

levels.name: Beginner Level
levels.description: Learning coding basics through block-based programming and simple text-based coding (Python, JavaScript).

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.description: Writing structured code, debugging, and developing small applications and interactive programs.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.description: Full-stack development, data structures, algorithms, and real-world software development projects.

name: AI
description: The AI track offers an in-depth exploration of artificial intelligence. Students will dive into AI concepts, learning how to create models and solutions using AI tools. Through hands-on projects, they’ll gain the skills to build their own AI models, developing both technical expertise and creativity in the field.

levels.name: Beginner Level
levels.description: Introduction to AI, basic machine learning concepts, and simple AI applications using visual programming.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.description: Hands-on machine learning projects, neural networks, and AI ethics, with real-world applications.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.description: Building AI models, automation, and deep learning techniques for advanced problem-solving.

name: Cyber Security
description: The cyber Security track provides kids with a foundational understanding of cybersecurity principles and practices. Through a structured, cumulative approach, students explore kecyber-Securityber-Securityconcepts like cyber threats, data protection, and safe online behavior.

levels.name: Beginner Level
levels.description: Fundamentals of cybersecurity, online safety, encryption basics, and ethical hacking introduction.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.description: Network security, penetration testing, and cyber threat detection with hands-on simulations.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.description: Advanced ethical hacking, cybersecurity frameworks, and digital forensics for real-world security challenges.

name: Creative Arts
description: The Creative Arts Track empowers students to explore the world of digital design, animation, and multimedia creation. Through a structured learning journey, they develop skills in graphic design, video editing, storytelling, and 3D modeling, enabling them to bring their creative ideas to life. This track nurtures artistic expression and technical proficiency, preparing students for careers in digital media,

levels.name: Beginner Level
levels.description: Exploring digital design, animation, and storytelling with basic graphic tools and software.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.description: Graphic design, video editing, interactive media creation, and 2D/3D design principles.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.description: Professional 3D modeling, game design, animation production, and advanced multimedia storytelling.

name: Robotics
description: The Robotics Track introduces students to the exciting world of robotics, automation, and engineering. Through a structured learning journey, they develop skills in robot design, programming, and hardware integration, working with sensors, motors, and microcontrollers like Arduino. This track nurtures problem-solving, innovation, and hands-on technical skills, preparing students for future careers in robotics, AI, and automation technologies.

levels.name: Beginner Level
levels.description: Introduction to robotics, understanding sensors, motors, and basic mechanical design.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.description: Hands-on robot building, programming robotic movements, and working with microcontrollers like Arduino.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.description: Advanced robotics engineering, AI-powered automation, and real-world applications like industrial robotics and autonomous systems.
